gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all priority schemes available in Jira so that I can understand how priorities are organized across different projects.
gold.ideal: The response should include a list of all priority schemes with their IDs and names.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to create a new priority scheme for my team so that we can manage task priorities effectively.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the priority scheme and return its ID and details.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to get suggested priorities for a set of mappings so that I can assign appropriate priorities to tasks.
gold.ideal: The response should provide a list of suggested priorities based on the provided mappings.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to see available priorities for a specific priority scheme so that I can assign them to issues.
gold.ideal: The response should return a list of available priorities for the specified priority scheme.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to delete an outdated priority scheme so that it no longer appears in the system.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the priority scheme.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update an existing priority scheme to reflect changes in our project priorities.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the update and return the updated details of the priority scheme.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to retrieve all priorities associated with a specific priority scheme to ensure they align with our project goals.
gold.ideal: The response should include a list of all priorities linked to the specified priority scheme.

gold.user: As a project coordinator, I want to find out which projects are using a specific priority scheme so that I can manage resources effectively.
gold.ideal: The response should return a list of projects associated with the specified priority scheme.
